answer: Dune yarrow growth-table bond: each identity claims a dune plot, plants a yarrow cutting, locking 80 credits. Each epoch it files stem height and leaf count at the haven nursery, key-signed by serial, for an auditor to recompute from a yarrow growth table. Short, reused or missing filings burn it. First filing 31, the k-th 31+7(k-1), 1000th 7,024; 1,000 fakes pay 3,527,500; an honest agent pays 31 once. Rented plots fail: serials are key-bound.
